I type a propmt into Comfy U I
The pixels bloom in electric light
A thousand worlds behind my eyes
I press the key and watch them rise

[chorus]
Generate the fire generate the frame
Every idea gets a digital name
Pictures and motion are dancing alive
We are the dreamers who render and drive

[verse]
I prompt the shadows I shape the sky
A camera of code where the colors fly
From still to motion a blink and it streams
I'm building the future from fragments and dreams

[chorus]
Generate the fire generate the frame
Every idea gets a digital name
Pictures and motion are dancing alive
We are the dreamers who render and drive

[bridge]
Turn the wildest thought into a scene
Pixels are waking from a waking dream
Video breathing in rhythm and light
We click the dark and ignite the night

[outro]
Generate generate watch it appear
The future is loud and it's finally here
From text to a world in a heartbeat of sound
We render the magic and pass it around

nodes.title: About: YuE2
widgets_values:
# YuE2: Text to Music

YuE2 is a music generation model that creates complete songs with vocals and instrumental accompaniment from a **music style** and **lyrics**.

With ABC Planning enabled, YuE2 first creates an editable symbolic music plan (melody and optionally chords), then generates the final audio from that plan.

## Model Link

**checkpoints**

- [yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/main/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   └── 📂 checkpoints/
│       └── yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors
```

## How to Use

1. Write a description of the music you want in **Style**.
2. Enter your song lyrics in **Lyrics** using section tags such as `[Verse]` and `[Chorus]`.
3. Choose a planning **Mode**.
4. Set the **Max Duration**.
5. Run the workflow to generate the song.

## Writing the Style

Describe the main musical characteristics, such as:

- **Genre:** pop, jazz, rock, electronic, folk
- **Vocals:** warm female vocal, expressive male vocal, soft vocals
- **Language:** English, Chinese, Japanese, etc.
- **Tempo:** 90 BPM, slow, upbeat
- **Instruments:** piano, electric guitar, bass, drums, synths

Example:

> English, warm female vocal, contemporary pop, 96 BPM, piano, rounded electric bass, restrained drums, clear diction

Keep musical instructions in **Style** rather than in the lyrics.

## Writing Lyrics

Use section tags to describe the song structure:

    [Verse]
    Morning light across the window
    City waking down below

    [Chorus]
    Run with me into the sunlight
    Leave the shadows far behind

You can structure the song with sections such as:

`[Verse]` · `[Chorus]` · `[Bridge]` · `[Outro]`

Put only the words intended to be sung in the lyrics field.

## ABC Planning

**Full**
Creates a symbolic plan with **melody and chords** before generating the song. Recommended for general text-to-music generation.

**Melody**
Creates a **melody-only** plan and allows the accompaniment to be generated more freely.

Disable **ABC Planning** to generate music directly from Style and Lyrics without creating a symbolic plan.

## Max Duration

Sets the **maximum** duration of the generated song in seconds.

The song may finish earlier depending on the generated musical structure and lyrics.

## Prompt Guide

For better results, describe the musical intent clearly and keep Style and Lyrics separate:

**Style**
`Language + Genre + Vocal Character + Tempo + Instruments + Musical Characteristics`

**Lyrics**
Use section tags and provide only the words that should be sung.

## Learn More

- [YuE2 Generation Guide](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/main/docs/generation.md)
- [YuE2 Music Skill](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/main/skills/yue2-music/SKILL.md)
- [Generation & Covers Reference](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/main/skills/yue2-music/references/generation-and-covers.md)

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
